claims.claim: Tim Cook said Apple Intelligence has been approved in China after years of regulatory delays, with a test version expected later in October.

claims.source_title: Tim Cook announces major Apple Intelligence update for China
claims.supporting_quote: According to Cook, the first batch of features will include writing tools, real-time translation and image cleanup. When it comes to rolling out the AI-powered Siri, he ruled out the possibility of its initial introduction.

claims.claim: Google is expanding opt-in Enhanced Protection in Android Messages so cloud Gemini models can read texts from unknown senders, rolling out in the coming weeks.

claims.episode_span: Google limits that check to the Pixel 10 and newer Pixels, the Galaxy S26 series, the Galaxy Z Fold8, the Galaxy Z Flip8 and other select devices.
claims.source_title: Google Messages: Gemini will soon screen texts from unknown senders
claims.supporting_quote: Google limits this to the Pixel 10 and newer Pixel models, the Galaxy S26 series, the Galaxy Z Fold8 , the Galaxy Z Flip8 and other select devices.

claims.claim: A University of Florida study of 175,430 user-reported scam texts found link-based scams reuse scripts while reply-based scams adapt and grew much faster.
claims.episode_span: A University of Florida study of 175,430 user-reported scam texts found that link-based scams, such as fake toll and postal notices, reuse near-identical scripts and are easier to filter.
claims.source_title: Google Gemini screens scam texts in Android Messages
claims.supporting_quote: A University of Florida study of 175,430 user-reported scam texts found link-based scams (fake toll and postal notices) reuse near-identical scripts, which makes them easy to filter. Reply-based scams like romance and wrong-number texts adapt to each victim, and they grew much faster.

claims.source_title: Google Gemini screens scam texts in Android Messages
claims.supporting_quote: $470M: Text scam losses reported to the FTC in 2024, at minimum.
